text: A股房地产板块涨幅扩大，新城控股、我爱我家拉升封板，深物业A、天健集团、粤宏远A等此前涨停，特发服务、滨江集团、华发股份、陆家嘴、世联行跟涨。
text_en: The A-share real estate sector extended gains, with Seazen Holdings and 5i5j pulling up to the limit up, while Shenwuye A, Tianjian Group, and Yuehongyuan A had previously hit the limit up, and Tefa Service, Binjiang Group, Huafa Holdings, Lujiazui, and World Union followed higher.
